description: Session context, the Bash call check, Markdown formatting and record note checks after an edit, and the prompt time for the record repository at KARO_HOME (default ~/karo).

hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" != "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" ] || [ ! -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/AGENTS.md" ] || { printf 'KARO_HOME=%s KARO_DATA_HOME=%s KARO_CONFIG_HOME=%s KARO_STATE_HOME=%s\n' "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" "${KARO_DATA_HOME:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/karo}" "${KARO_CONFIG_HOME:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/karo}" "${KARO_STATE_HOME:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/karo}"; cat "${KARO_STATE_HOME:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/karo}/state.md" 2>/dev/null || true; echo '記録を書く・bd で書く・委任する前に、使う karo の skill を Skill tool で呼び直す（compact で戻された skill の中身は、古い版のことがある）。'; }

[ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" != "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" ] || [ ! -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/AGENTS.md" ] || { printf 'KARO_HOME=%s KARO_DATA_HOME=%s KARO_CONFIG_HOME=%s KARO_STATE_HOME=%s\n' "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" "${KARO_DATA_HOME:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/karo}" "${KARO_CONFIG_HOME:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/karo}" "${KARO_STATE_HOME:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/karo}"; cat "${KARO_STATE_HOME:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/karo}/state.md" 2>/dev/null || true; }

[ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" != "${KARO_HOME:-$HOME/karo}" ] || [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.beads" ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; bd prime; echo '## bd: in_progress'; bd list --status in_progress --limit 0 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .status, (.assignee // "-"), ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 判断待ち'; bd human list --status open; echo '## bd: ready'; bd ready --exclude-type decision --limit 10 --json | jq -r '.[]? | [.id, .priority, ((.labels // []) | map(select(startswith("project:"))) | join(",")), .title] | @tsv'; echo '## bd: 件数'; bd count --by-status; }
